import numpy as np, steal, forward as F
T=F.A1/np.linalg.norm(F.A1,axis=1,keepdims=True)
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
for _ in range(3):
  x0=rng.normal(size=10); d=rng.normal(size=10); d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
  ks=steal.find_kinks(x0,d,-20,20)
  for t in ks:
    gp=steal.grad(x0+(t+1e-3)*d); gm=steal.grad(x0+(t-1e-3)*d)
    df=gp-gm; df/=np.linalg.norm(df); c=np.abs(T@df)
    if c.max()<0.999: print(t, c.max(), np.sort(c)[-3:])
EOF
